Defects #136 and #143. A feature's cost claims to be an upper bound even when the feature is only ever the secondary on a shared session, where it is charged nothing and the figure is really a lower bound. The {value, gaps} shape is spelled separately by cost, work time and defects, so each site decides on its own what counts as a gap. One shared definition of a qualified figure, with its bound derived from how it was charged, fixes both.
